a2dcb75.summary: Phase 0. Adds rigidBodyEnd, a point-mass body owned by beamFoam and attached to a beam end. Also adds partitioned coupling with converged coupling iterations, and standalone tests against analytic results. Fixes two existing bugs.
details: rigidBodyEnd.H/.C (new): mass, external force, gravity, Newmark update, newTimeStep() by time index, history file postProcessing/rigidBodyEnd

coupledTotalLagNewtonRaphsonBeamRigidBodyEnd.C (new): reads rigidBodyCoupling none | partitioned | monolithic; evolve() dispatches to evolvePartitionedRigidBodyEnd(), and the old evolve() becomes evolveBeam()
Bug fix, Evolve.C: the Newmark predictor is applied once per time step (newmarkPredictorTimeIndex_), not on every repeated solve

Bug fix, beamModel.C: the gravity rho check moved to after rho_ is filled (it crashed cases with a g file and per-beam rho); new tutorials/rigidBodyEnd (hangingMass, axialOscillation, pendulum) with checkRigidBodyEnd.py

0b3fa2b.summary: Marks Phase 0 as completed in the development plan PDF.

359e651.summary: Phase 1. Solves the body's translation in the same Newton iteration as the beam, inside BlockEigenSolverOF: true monolithic coupling for translation.
details: RigidBodyCouplingData.H: new RigidBodyMonolithicCoupling (attachment cell, beam-row and body-row coefficients, body source)

BlockEigenSolverOF.C/.H: setMonolithicCoupling(); body columns +CQW/pDelta on the end cell's force rows and +CMQW/pDelta on its moment rows; body rows R = m a + c v - F_ext - m g + Q_b; the increment is returned in rigidBodySolution

RigidBodyEnd.C: evolveMonolithicRigidBodyEnd(), setRigidBodyEndIterate(), rigidBodyEndMonolithicCoupling() (boundary terms assembled alone into zeroed fields), checkRigidBodyEndJacobian() (finite-difference check)
Evolve.C: hooks before updateCoeffs and after the solve (x += dx; the attachment W is updated); deltaXNorm includes the body increment

03bbd7d.summary: Phase 2. Adds body rotation to both couplings: inertia tensor, centre of mass away from the attachment, angular velocity, damping and external moment, all solved monolithically with the beam.
details: rigidBodyEnd: orientation exp(theta)·Q_n with Newmark on theta; moment balance J alpha + omega x J omega + c_r omega - M_ext - r x F_beam; rotationalResidual(), rotationJacobian() with the SO(3) left Jacobian T(theta); arm(), attachmentDisplacement()
BlockEigenSolverOF.C: rotation rows and columns, plus translation-rotation cross terms
RigidBodyCouplingData.H: rotation coefficients (bodyRot*, beam*RowRotCoeff) and RigidBodyEndState
New tutorials hangingBody, freeRotation and compoundPendulum; checkRigidBodyEnd.py grows to 54 checks

83acbbb.summary: Phase 3, beamFoam side. Adds a beamModel interface so a caller (moorFV) can create the body, set its applied load each step and read back the solved state. Adds the interFoam case using moorFV's new beamFoamCoupled solver.
details: beamModel.H: virtual initialiseRigidBodyEnd(dict, gravity), setRigidBodyEndExternalLoad(F, M) and getRigidBodyEndState()
rigidBodyEnd: initial orientation; inertia and arm in body axes; setExternalLoad(); the history folder is named after the start time
RigidBodyEnd.C: createRigidBodyEnd(); the Jacobian check uses central differences
tutorials/rigidBodyAndBeam_beamFoamCoupled with checkCoupledState.py and Alltest (moorFV's state equals beamFoam's to about 2e-10)

bf5bbbe.summary: Renames codexLogs/ to documentation/. Its message describes all of Phase 4, but a failed git add left only the rename in this commit; the remaining files are in 74ebab7.

74ebab7.summary: Phase 4. Adds the converged-reference interFoam cases, the stress-test generator, updated plotting scripts and the outer-corrector / Newmark note, and marks Phase 4 completed in the plan.
details: rigidBodyAndBeam_loop_nOuter8, rigidBodyAndBeam_beamFoamCoupled_nOuter8: nOuterCorrectors 8, moveMeshOuterCorrectors yes
rigidBodyAndBeam_stress: makeCases (stiffLine, lightBody, stiffLight, stiffLargeDt x 4 methods; removes 0/beam/CQ and CM so E takes effect), Allrun (parallel), summarise.py
plot_rigidBodyAndBeam_new_vs_old.py rewritten for several cases with a reference and CASE_SET; the efficiency script gets stress-case labels and summed Newton iterations
documentation/outerCorrectorsAndNewmark.pdf and documentation/source/ (HTML, model.py, figs.py); codexLogs references updated

36393fb.summary: Phase 3, moorFV side. New sixDoF solver beamFoamCoupled: moorFV hands the fluid load to beamFoam, which solves beam and body together; moorFV then copies the solved state as it is.
details: beamFoamCoupled.H/.C (new): applied load = fluid force/moment with weight + other restraints (explicit); calls finiteVolumeBeam::solveMonolithic; sets centre of rotation, Q, v, a, pi = J·(Q^T omega), tau
finiteVolumeBeam.C/.H: solveMonolithic(motion, force, moment, solverDict); on the first call it sets up beamFoam's body from the motion (no gravity in beamFoam)
sixDoFFvBeamSolver.H / I.H: protected accessors restraints(), constraints() and initialCentreOfRotation()
Make/files registers the solver; the beamFoam submodule points to 83acbbb

f1bd195.summary: Points the beamFoam submodule at 74ebab7 (Phase 4 validation and documentation).
